title: Foil Cross with Wires
description: Cross-shaped assemblage constructed from cardboard, crumpled copper-toned foil, compact discs, and small electronic components, mounted against a layered metallic and red-striped background. White wires descend loosely from the horizontal arms; a small purple-labeled disc is affixed near the lower vertical shaft, and yellow painted marks are visible at center.
composition: central cross on foil ground with dripping wires
